title: System Design Fundamentals
summary: Learn how production design choices define the behavior users can rely on.
audience: Engineers preparing for system design interviews, architecture reviews, and production tradeoff discussions.

units.title: Caching Contracts
units.summary: Study freshness, invalidation, diagrams, and review prompts through a short cache design loop.

units.title: Capacity Decisions
units.summary: Measure a constraint, compare interventions and preserve a scaling decision receipt.

units.title: Routing Decisions
units.summary: Compare signals, eligibility and affinity through an original static routing experiment.

units.title: API Security Boundaries
units.summary: Distinguish browser response sharing, request forgery and server object authorization.

units.title: Client Compatibility
units.summary: Separate layout capabilities, fresh data and API meaning; test cached fallback and cold starts.

units.title: Traffic Rate Contracts
units.summary: Define precise rate windows, burst capacity and concurrency scope before choosing storage.

units.title: Webhook Authenticity
units.summary: Separate signed delivery, replay admission and durable effects with original local evidence.

units.title: Reservation Boundaries
units.summary: Trace atomic inventory claims, expiry and late completion without inventing queue guarantees.

units.title: Distributed Reading Reviews
units.summary: Compare quorum membership, consensus commitment and fan-out evidence through selected primary readings.

units.title: Video Delivery Contracts
units.summary: Review segment deadlines, protection observations and accepted playback revisions independently.
